title: DARPA Lift Challenge Competitor and Live-Trial Announcement
summary: DARPA named the first 72 invited Lift Challenge teams after more than 480 applications and scheduled a five-nautical-mile live performance trial in Dayton, Ohio, for August 2-9, 2026, with $6.5 million in prizes.
key_findings: More than 200 teams completed critical requirements and milestones before the first 72 invitations were announced.
The live trial is designed to compare payload-to-weight performance on a five-nautical-mile circuit.
The competition is scheduled for August 2-9, 2026 at the National Museum of the U.S. Air Force.
why_it_matters: The record converts a broad DARPA logistics and aviation research direction into named performers and a dated field-test gate.
ftfn_relevance: Provides a bounded DARPA program-activity record beyond a budget request or solicitation.
Creates a dated recheck for measured performance, prize awards, and transition evidence.
evidence_limits: Invitations and a scheduled event do not prove that the trial occurred or that any design met the performance target.
The announcement does not establish certification, procurement, production readiness, service economics, or operational adoption.
